review_corrections.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: three cloth-only INBETWEEN cels for an existing 2D game idle animation. Input image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE eight-phase cloth atlas, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows. Number source cels ZERO-BASED in reading order: TOP ROW 0,1,2,3; BOTTOM ROW 4,5,6,7. Input image 2 is the REJECTED three-cel attempt: use it only to understand that large new scarf curls and invented gussets are WRONG. Draw a replacement with exactly THREE cloth-only cels in ONE horizontal row, wide transparent gutters and complete margins. First new cel: subtle exact visual halfway phase between SOURCE 2 (top row third) and SOURCE 4 (bottom row first). Second new cel: subtle halfway phase SOURCE 6 (bottom row third) to SOURCE 7 (bottom row fourth). Third new cel: subtle halfway phase SOURCE 7 to SOURCE 1 (top row second). All endpoint differences are very small: do NOT invent a new gust, do NOT make a new large upper scarf arc. Carefully preserve each pair's SAME cloth silhouette family, fold topology, torn edge teeth, ink contours and texture. Match the gently sloping thin red scarf in image 1, and the teal hanging cape's existing bottom pointed tears; each new red hem, teal tip and principal fold lies visually halfway between its specified two endpoints. The red scarf's outline must stay within the neighboring endpoints' small contour envelope, not puff up like rejected image 2. Lock the collar at the upper-right at the same local position in every cel, identical uniform cloth scale. Scarf trails left, teal cape trails left-down. Pure detached red scarf plus teal cape ONLY. No person, body, face, hair, skin, arms, hands, legs, weapon, clasp or accessories. Crisp dark ink contours and textured muted red/teal hand-painted rendering exactly matching source atlas. Genuine transparent alpha outside precise cloth, no colored aura, background, shadow, text, labels, border or checkerboard. These must be close intermediate phases, not three unrelated cloth designs. Output original production source sheet with three equal cells.
